meta.name: Me
meta.description: New school. New family. New superpower. It's a season of change for 12-year-old Ben Vasani when he discovers that he can transform into anyone he meets. As a shapeshifter, Ben must figure out who he is and who he wants to be.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Ben struggles to navigate major life changes when an encounter with a bully leads to a mysterious transformation.

videos.title: Lines in the Sand
videos.overview: Max and Ben start their search for answers. Darren embarks on his own investigation as secrets from his past begin to surface.

videos.title: Facing Up
videos.overview: In trying to trigger his own abilities, Ben lands Max in a tricky spot and gives Carter reason to question Ben's choices.

videos.title: Opportunity Costs
videos.overview: Ben sets out to expose Jason while Darren's determination sparks concern. Phil reveals a thoughtful surprise.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: A covert mission takes shape on Max's birthday. Meanwhile, the pressure to please her parents becomes a burden.

videos.title: The Lighthouse
videos.overview: Hoping to better understand the past, Ben and Max visit Darren at home—and connect with a familiar stranger.

videos.title: Turning Point
videos.overview: An enemy's return brings danger to the town of Boatright. Ben's bold move threatens to destroy his relationship with Max.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: While a rift challenges the family, Carter's past proves critical to understanding Yates' reign of terror.

videos.title: Head in the Sand
videos.overview: Faced with a desperate plea, Ben decides how to use his powers and digs deep to define who he wants to be.

videos.title: The End of the Beginning
videos.overview: The spring dance turns into the ultimate showdown as Yates seeks revenge and Ben and his allies attempt to end the chaos.
